title: Pietro

difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 1 kg of ready-to-cook John Dory
- 280 g of riso fino rice
- 1 l of court-bouillon
- 10 g of butter
- 30 g of sour butter
## Method
1. Place the fish in the cooking vessel, cover it with the court-bouillon, and cook for about 20 minutes.
2. Drain it and fillet it.
3. In a saucepan, melt the butter and toast the rice for one minute.
4. Add the boiling broth one ladle at a time, so that the liquid just covers the surface of the rice, and cook until done.
5. Turn off the heat and stir in the sour butter.
6. Distribute the risotto on plates, arrange the fish on top, and serve.
